cur-fossil-liang-bua.dateNote: In September 2003 a team digging this cave on Flores found LB1, a tiny adult human: Homo floresiensis. Its bones are about 100,000–60,000 years old (0.1–0.06 million years).

cur-fossil-mata-menge.dateNote: In 2014 a team led by Gerrit van den Bergh found a jaw and teeth of tiny early humans at Mata Menge, central Flores, Indonesia. They are about 0.7 million years old, likely ancestors of Homo floresiensis, the "hobbit".
cur-fossil-mata-menge.summary: Where the likely ancestors of the Flores "hobbit" were found.
